In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] gave her son [[Ben Skywalker]] a '''vibroblade'''. Unknown to Ben, it had a [[hyperspace transponder]] which Mara used to find him whenever she was unable to sense him with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Because of Ben's possession of the vibroblade that Jade learned that he was on [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]] when the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] Prime Minister, [[Dur Gejjen]], was [[Mission to Vulpter|assassinated]] by a [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] assassin, Ben Skywalker himself. Mara later used the [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] again while she was following [[Lumiya]]; however, Ben had left it in [[Lon Shevu]]'s apartment, and was in fact following Mara.
